Title: Public preview: Azure Log Analytics in CENTRAL US, EAST US 2, EAST ASIA, WEST US, & SOUTH Central US

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Azure Log Analytics is available for preview in five new regions: CENTRAL US, EAST US 2, EAST ASIA, WEST US, & SOUTH Central US.

You can learn more about Log Analytics here and explore for additional regional availability in this link.
